policy: cc9 host policy: single-threaded; main-thread and fixed-step unit math at x87 PC=24 (float); Dyn solver and collision tasks at PC=53.
host_build: bsp_core/bsp_game: MSVC Win32, /fp:strict, default /arch:SSE2. C++ float = SSE single (rounded per op), C++ double = SSE2 double (53-bit, unaffected by the x87 control word). Inline __asm x87 runs at the calling thread's x87 PC; bsp_game's main thread is at PC=24 after its own CreateDevice (no FPU_PRESERVE).
method: local/pr1_census.py parses every function in src/*.cpp and include/bsp/*.hpp, takes the image address from the name suffix, the comment block above, or the first body comment, counts arithmetic-type evidence (log/printf arguments removed), and joins the address to the image thread class: Dyn worker = direct-call closure of 00403720, 00403850, 00403CC0 plus the narrow-phase dispatch targets; Dyn calling thread = 00C30000..00C6FFFF otherwise; fixed-step job = closure of 00825F20, 00953CC0, 007F3BA0, 006E6490, 0070C370, 0092B350; everything else main thread. Score = 3*chains + 2*double locals + 2*unnarrowed double casts + 0.5*double-constant uses + inexact literals, times 3 for gameplay/Dyn lanes.

classes.A_main_widened: host computes in double where the image (main thread, PC=24) rounds every x87 op to 24 bits
classes.B_dyn_worker_narrowed: host computes at 24 bits (SSE float, or inline x87 on the PC=24 main thread) where the image runs on a Dyn worker at 53 bits
classes.C_lua_vm: stock Lua 5.1.1 lua_Number arithmetic in SSE2 double; image Lua runs on the main thread at PC=24
